title: 同意 / 反對
description: 表達同意或反對的用語

sentences.en: I completely agree with your assessment.
sentences.zh: 我完全同意你的評估。

sentences.en: I disagree with that statement.
sentences.zh: 我不同意那個說法。

sentences.en: Absolutely, that's exactly what I was thinking.
sentences.zh: 完全同意，那正是我在想的。

sentences.en: I'm not sure about that; let me think it over.
sentences.zh: 我對此不太確定，讓我想一想。

sentences.en: You have a point, but I see it differently.
sentences.zh: 你說得有道理，但我有不同的看法。

sentences.en: I couldn't agree more with your suggestion.
sentences.zh: 我非常同意你的建議。

sentences.en: I'm afraid I have to disagree on this matter.
sentences.zh: 恐怕我在這件事上不得不持反對意見。

sentences.en: That's a fair point; I hadn't considered that.
sentences.zh: 這是個好觀點，我之前沒有考慮到。

sentences.en: I see what you mean, but I think otherwise.
sentences.zh: 我明白你的意思，但我有不同的想法。

sentences.en: You're absolutely right about that.
sentences.zh: 你在這一點上完全正確。

sentences.en: I beg to differ on this particular issue.
sentences.zh: 在這個特定問題上我有不同意見。

sentences.en: That's exactly how I feel about it.
sentences.zh: 那正是我對此的感受。

sentences.en: I'm not entirely convinced by that argument.
sentences.zh: 我沒有完全被那個論點說服。

sentences.en: I'm with you on that one.
sentences.zh: 在那一點上我和你意見一致。

sentences.en: I respectfully disagree with your conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我恭敬地不同意你的結論。

sentences.en: I think we're on the same page here.
sentences.zh: 我想我們在這一點上是一致的。

sentences.en: I have mixed feelings about that proposal.
sentences.zh: 對於那個提案我有著複雜的感受。

sentences.en: I see your point, and I largely agree.
sentences.zh: 我理解你的觀點，而且我大部分同意。

sentences.en: I don't think that's entirely accurate.
sentences.zh: 我不認為那完全準確。

sentences.en: We definitely see eye to eye on this.
sentences.zh: 在這一點上我們絕對是意見一致的。

sentences.en: I partially agree, but there are some exceptions.
sentences.zh: 我部分同意，但有一些例外。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but I can't support that idea.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，但我無法支持那個想法。

sentences.en: That makes a lot of sense to me.
sentences.zh: 那對我來說很有道理。

sentences.en: I'm opposed to that approach for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 由於幾個原因，我反對那種做法。

sentences.en: I share your concerns about this issue.
sentences.zh: 我和你一樣對這個問題感到擔憂。

sentences.en: I'm not so sure that's the right way to go.
sentences.zh: 我不太確定那是正確的方向。

sentences.en: You've made a compelling argument; I'm persuaded.
sentences.zh: 你提出了一個有說服力的論點，我被說服了。

sentences.en: I have reservations about that plan.
sentences.zh: 我對那個計畫有所保留。

sentences.en: I wholeheartedly support your decision.
sentences.zh: 我全心全意支持你的決定。

sentences.en: With all due respect, I think you're mistaken.
sentences.zh: 恕我直言，我認為你弄錯了。
